results.title: How to measure interdisciplinary research? A systemic design ...
results.content: This study proposes a systemic design, grounded in an advanced literature review, to demonstrate that the quantification of the interdisciplinarity of research can be treated as a process of decision-making in mathematical modelling, where alternatives choices are evaluated based on how closely their mathematical properties align with the theoretical objectives of the research design. If the title of this manuscript caught the attention of a reader, then perhaps he or she has been (or will be) in the position to assess quantitatively the interdisciplinarity of a body of research made of scientific articles, journals, institutions, or even careers.
